inspectionNotes.arabic: Both Arabic phrases visually present and separated in the Linux PDFs. Poppler extraction is partial; no claim of reliable Arabic selection/search/reading order.
inspectionNotes.escaped: Decoded-leaf edits intentionally replace only the selected glyph span, retaining adjacent literal characters. Untouched punctuation and sections remain visible.

fixtures.limits: Structure preserves visible text but does not reproduce TeX layout.
Known resume macros expose mapped arguments. Arbitrary expansion and inserted literal text (ExpansionOnlyMarker) are not executed in Structure.
Structure preserves visible text but does not reproduce TeX layout.
Table cells are mapped. Column positions, widths and minipage layout are approximate in Structure; PDF is the layout authority.
Literal includes are navigated as separate files with file-local offsets; Structure does not flatten the document. Duplicate text in another file must stay unchanged.
Latin accents and a non-BMP comment preceding mapped offsets are tested. Emoji glyphs, CJK and arbitrary script/font coverage are not established.

XeLaTeX with polyglossia, bidi and Amiri only. Structure displays logical Unicode text approximately; native RTL shaping, font layout and PDF reading order require separate checks. PDF Arabic text extraction is partial; Arabic phrases require explicit visual review.
Eight explicit pages and 96 numbered entries are checked. This is not evidence for arbitrarily large or deeply nested projects.
TeX expands the dynamic input for PDF. Structure cannot resolve or navigate it and must emit an unsupported-include diagnostic; edit it externally or use literal inputs.
Intentional missing package control. This is a setup failure, not a parser defect; the runtime must not install it.
Intentionally malformed braces must be distinguished from limited Structure support and missing packages.

visualReview.reviewer: Codex visual inspection; not a human sign-off
visualReview.method: Every rendered page inspected. 100 page images matched SHA-256 identities of already inspected native-resolution contact sheets; the two newly compiled XeLaTeX macro pages were inspected as full-page PNGs. Page geometry and required text independently checked by the matrix.
visualReview.status: All rendered pages inspected; no apparent clipping, collision or section omission.
